patterns: A coastal shield threatens its own civilian shelters. Evacuate the lower city, mark a narrow firing arc and face the actual cost of defense.
A fuel convoy conceals civilian air. Verify quotas, protect neutral repairs and win independent access without destroying shared life support.
A giant marked for scrap still carries living pilots. Wake its crew, negotiate salvage consent and find a route for two answering frames.
factions:
Harbor Shield Assembly|must evacuate the lower city before firing a shield that floods its own shelters
Free Orbit Union|seeks civilian independence without burning the colony's shared oxygen plant
Wreck Commons|salvages sleeping frames under an agreement to leave occupied wrecks intact
District Ferry Crew|will open evacuation lanes if defense command shares its remaining shield capacity
Life Support Cooperative|can verify oxygen quotas hidden in the military requisition
Quiet Core Custodians|recognizes that the largest wreck is still carrying a living crew
Coastal Frame Command|holds an outdated targeting order that treats inhabited levees as expendable
Independent Maintenance Circle|can repair either side's frames if pilots protect its neutral work bays

scenes:
Alarm below the Shield|Objective: establish a safe civilian evacuation corridor. Show the obsolete shelter map and ferry demand; reroute ammunition or open the coastal ramp. Delay traps patients
The Air Is Not Fuel|Objective: verify civilian air ownership. Compare the duplicate ledger with canister seals or make a witnessed pressure test. Delay permits armed convoy departure
Someone Lives in the Wreck|Objective: stop unsafe salvage. Listen to cabin replies or inspect intact life support; isolate the cutting rig while keeping the core powered. Delay cuts an occupied section
Ferries before Batteries|Objective: clear the shared lift. Negotiate cargo priority or manually release its jammed hoist with reactor expense. Delay strands the medical shelter
The Neutral Bay|Objective: protect oxygen production. Clear armed frames from maintenance or move inspection into the transfer ring. Delay reduces air available for the vote
Wake without Weapons|Objective: ask the sleeping crew for consent. Use the unarmed access key or transmit the wake protocol; weapons stay isolated. Delay lets a rival claim abandoned status
A Narrow Firing Arc|Objective: redirect the coastal threat. Mark no-fire limits and use low-power lures or shield the ferry route while drawing it seaward. Delay damages the relay
Canisters in Public|Objective: expose quota fraud safely. Count air with habitat witnesses or escort the clerk through neutral repairs. Delay leaves civilian ownership disputed
The Price of Scrap|Objective: settle the rival claim without stripping living cabins. Offer verified unoccupied hull or a witnessed deferred debt. Delay brings a claim cutter
The Pylon Choice|Objective: keep evacuation open before defense fires. Bypass the relay for reduced field strength or take the slower coastal escort. Delay closes the narrow-shot window
A Charter for Breath|Objective: distribute air without forced military service. Agree to public quotas and an appeals path or temporary shared custody. Delay exhausts the waiting habitat
Tow a Living Giant|Objective: move the frame on terms its crew accepts. Negotiate the signal yard crossing or brace safely until morning. Delay overheats exposed support rigs
The Last Shelter Count|Objective: account for all civilians before the shot. Reconcile manifests or send a rescue frame to the missing shelter. Delay permits command's obsolete order
Independent Docking|Objective: secure a neutral future air corridor. Test the agreed charter against a live convoy and remove armed oversight. Delay revives requisition priority
The Second Waking|Objective: extend occupied protections to the neighboring giant. Relay the charter or offer an unarmed departure corridor. Delay risks two giants colliding
Repair after the Alarm|Objective: record the actual cost of defending the city. Assign levee repairs and shelter restitution; reduce remaining battery capacity if needed. Delay leaves lower streets flooded
Habitat Ledger|Objective: verify air deliveries and civilian choice. Record each habitat's actual reserve and a visible appeal; let a minority retain independent custody. Delay hides a new shortage
What the Commons Keep|Objective: define consensual salvage and crew autonomy. Mark powered exclusions and unoccupied claims; living frames choose their route. Delay starts the next scrap dispute

Shield Technician|trades maximum field strength for a evacuation corridor residents can actually cross
Neutral Bay Mechanic|repairs life support only under an enforceable clear-worksite agreement
Consent Archivist|asks awakened pilots to choose a tow route and records revocable salvage terms
Coastal Rescue Pilot|tracks missing shelters and accepts a delayed shot to finish the count
Commons Rig Lead|braces inhabited frames and verifies which scrap is safe to remove
